root_cause: The original customer-value daily briefing selects only an eligible next action and excludes DONE and COMPLETED. The authenticated executive projection truncated next_best_actions to five and had no historical action projection. Thus users cannot distinguish a recorded completion from independently confirmed execution, matched actual value, following learning and ONE BRAIN closure. Production source also has 829 done action-value entries but none with proven net resource economics. This is a visibility and handoff gap, not proof of customer savings.

semantic_learning.cause: A next-recommendation-only projection hides earlier recorded actions, while DONE labels may incorrectly be read as measured savings and completed closure.
semantic_learning.prevention_rule: In the original executive tenant read model separately retain source-backed action history and show recorded status, independent execution, verified same-action outcome, verified financial net and ONE BRAIN closure receipt as distinct stages.
semantic_learning.next_owner: Original Company Intelligence OS tenant data producer -> original ONE BRAIN action executor -> Heartbeat outcome and original portal
